activity: Order confirmation email (Shopify notification)
lawful_basis: UK GDPR 6(1)(b) contract; PECR marketing rules do not apply to non-promotional service content
current_practice: Shopify notification; ops/email/flows/post-purchase.md draft adds a what-happens-next block (no promotion)
gap: None if kept free of promotion (no 'new beds', no cross-sell)
recommended_control: Keep content service-only; no product promotion or newsletter blocks in notifications

activity: Workshop/dispatch/delivery-date emails, calls and WhatsApp to buyers
current_practice: Sent by hand (post-purchase.md emails 2-3); phone/WhatsApp
gap: None if service-only
recommended_control: Service-only wording; WhatsApp only to numbers the buyer gave for this order

activity: Aftercare / care tips after delivery (post-purchase email 4)
consent_or_soft_optin_needed: No if service-only; yes (consent or soft opt-in) if it promotes products
current_practice: Draft only, sent by hand; contains care tips + review ask; no product promotion
gap: Risk only if extra products or offers are added
recommended_control: No product links, offers or 'shop new beds' lines; if promotion is wanted, send only to subscribed/soft-opt-in buyers with unsubscribe

activity: Review request (Judge.me request + 1 reminder; Google review ask)
message_type: service if neutral wording; marketing if promotional
consent_or_soft_optin_needed: No if service-only wording (ICO view on pure feedback requests: HYPOTHESIS, no specific page retrieved); yes if promotional
current_practice: Judge.me requests likely ON at default 14 days after fulfilment (ESTIMATE Stage 3); R-request template is neutral, no incentive
gap: No unsubscribe/opt-out line confirmed in Judge.me email; Judge.me footer UNKNOWN; must not add offers or product suggestions
recommended_control: Keep R-request wording (no product links, no discount, no 'shop now'); 1 request + 1 reminder; check Judge.me adds an opt-out link; honour opt-outs in suppression list
owner_or_professional_review: Professional: confirm review requests to non-subscribed buyers are service messages

activity: Abandoned-checkout follow-up (Shopify Messaging 'You left items at checkout')
message_type: marketing (ICO generally treats as marketing; drafts also promote swatches, delivery, finance)
lawful_basis: PECR reg 22: consent; UK GDPR 6(1)(a) or 6(1)(f)
consent_or_soft_optin_needed: Yes: consent, or soft opt-in only if 'negotiations for a sale' + opt-out offered at collection (legal view split)
current_practice: Targets 'subscribed' customers only; automation status draft/active UNKNOWN (went to draft 19 Nov)
gap: 12 of 38 subscribed customer records have 0 orders (VERIFIED 19 Nov). If those subscriptions came from a pre-ticked box before 19 Nov the consent is not valid, so 'subscribed only' does not fully fix it. Email 2 preview text mentions Clearpay (banned claim)
recommended_control: Before re-activating: (a) confirm how the box behaved before 19 Nov; (b) if it was pre-ticked, exclude customers subscribed before the fix who have no order from all marketing including this flow; (c) remove 'Clearpay' from email 2; (d) unsubscribe link in every email
owner_or_professional_review: Professional: abandoned-checkout lawful basis and treatment of pre-19 Nov subscribers

activity: Newsletter / promotional email or SMS to past buyers
lawful_basis: PECR reg 22 consent or soft opt-in; UK GDPR 6(1)(a)/(f)
current_practice: Shopify marketing checkbox now unticked (owner fixed 19 Nov). 38 of 73 customers 'SUBSCRIBED' (26 buyers, 12 non-buyers), all SINGLE_OPT_IN (VERIFIED)
gap: Validity of subscriptions collected before 19 Nov is UNKNOWN (if box was pre-ticked, consent invalid; buyers may still qualify for soft opt-in only if they had a way to refuse at checkout)
recommended_control: Send marketing only to: post-19 Nov ticked subscribers, plus buyers if a professional confirms soft opt-in; every message has unsubscribe; never email to 'ask for consent'
owner_or_professional_review: Professional: soft opt-in for pre-fix buyers

activity: Swatch request and swatch follow-up
consent_or_soft_optin_needed: No for the swatch itself and 1 follow-up about it; yes for later promotions unless soft opt-in conditions met
current_practice: Templates treat as one-to-one service replies (swatch-follow-up.md)
gap: None if no newsletter add without consent
recommended_control: Do not add swatch requesters to marketing lists unless they tick a box; keep follow-ups to the request

activity: Replies to enquiries (WhatsApp, email, phone, Shopify Inbox)
current_practice: 17 enquiry templates (Stage 3)
gap: Later promotional follow-ups to enquirers need soft opt-in conditions (opt-out at collection) - not set up
recommended_control: Answer the question asked; no later promotional messages unless they opted in

activity: WhatsApp broadcast / promotional messages
lawful_basis: PECR reg 22 (WhatsApp treated like email/SMS - HYPOTHESIS, no ICO page naming WhatsApp)
current_practice: No broadcasts found; WhatsApp Business used for enquiries (SETUP.md)
gap: None today
recommended_control: No broadcast lists unless each contact opted in for WhatsApp specifically; record opt-in date; honour STOP

activity: SMS marketing
current_practice: Not used (SMS consent not checked)
gap: None today
recommended_control: Same as email; separate SMS consent

activity: Trade cold email to limited companies / LLPs / plcs at role addresses (info@, sales@)
lawful_basis: PECR reg 22 does not apply; identity + valid opt-out address required; UK GDPR 6(1)(f) where the address identifies a person
consent_or_soft_optin_needed: No consent; LIA + Art.14 privacy info needed
current_practice: Since 19 Nov limited companies only (reported by caller; NOT in ops/email/trade-agent-brief.txt, which still says only 'skip sole traders who are clearly individuals'); 292+61 sent in total; STOP line; sender identified
gap: No privacy line/link; no written LIA; legal-form check and its source not recorded per lead; repo brief not updated
recommended_control: Legal-form gate (Companies House number recorded per lead); add privacy line; write LIA; global suppression check before send; cap 1 follow-up
owner_or_professional_review: Owner: approve LIA + footer. Professional: optional sign-off of LIA

activity: Trade cold email to named employees of companies (jane@company)
current_practice: Not done: role addresses only
gap: None
recommended_control: Keep role addresses only; if ever named, same LIA + privacy line, and stop on any objection

activity: Earlier trade batches (before 19 Nov) to B&Bs, guest houses, holiday cottages, small landlords, some designers
recipient_type: likely sole traders / non-Scottish partnerships = individual subscribers
lawful_basis: PECR reg 22 requires prior consent (soft opt-in impossible for cold prospects)
current_practice: Sent without legal-form check (ESTIMATE up to ~110 of first 253 in sole-trader-heavy segments; real number UNKNOWN). 3 STOPs, all hospitality
gap: Probable PECR reg 22 breach for every recipient that is an individual subscriber
recommended_control: Stop all further email to these; Companies House check of every contacted lead; mark non-companies doNotContact; no apology or 'correction' mailing; keep a dated record of the review
owner_or_professional_review: Professional: confirm remediation; whether any self-report is advisable

activity: Trade email to Scottish partnerships
recipient_type: corporate subscriber (Scottish partnerships are legal persons)
current_practice: Not tracked
gap: Hard to verify (no public register for general partnerships)
recommended_control: Treat as individual unless status is evidenced; simplest rule: email only entities with a Companies House number

activity: Trade email to charities, care homes, universities, councils
recipient_type: corporate if incorporated (charitable company, CIO, public body); unincorporated trusts/associations = individual
current_practice: Care homes on hold (fire-safety claims); some university/council sends
gap: Legal form not checked
recommended_control: Email only if Companies House or Charity Commission shows a company or CIO, or it is a public body

activity: Follow-up email to non-replying corporate prospects
current_practice: Rule 'never the same business twice' (PLAN.md)
gap: None
recommended_control: Max 1 follow-up after 10+ working days; then stop; suppression check first

activity: Replies and quotes to interested trade prospects (e.g. design studio)
current_practice: Interested replies routed to owner
gap: Free-assembly wording already sent must be corrected in the quote
recommended_control: Quote with true terms (assembly optional £69.99)

activity: Trade enquiry form on website (planned)

current_practice: Not built

recommended_control: Use the form line in 04-compliance.md s5; optional unticked trade-news box; record consent text + timestamp

current_practice: Not started

recommended_control: Screen against TPS and CTPS within 28 days before calling; log screen date; note any 'do not call'

activity: Cookies and pixels (Shopify banner; Meta, TikTok, Google Ads, GTM, GA4)

recommended_control: Test with a fresh browser: no Meta/TikTok/Ads requests before 'Accept'; 'Reject' as easy as 'Accept'; list cookies in privacy policy

activity: Customer-match / custom audience uploads (Google Ads, Meta)

current_practice: Not used (Stage 5 suggested cart-abandoner signals, which are cookie-based)

activity: Suppression list (STOPs, objections, bounces, unsubscribes)

activity: HQ 'leads' store (business names, role emails, source URLs, full message text)

gap: Storage limitation and minimisation
recommended_control: Retention schedule s4; drop full message body after 90 days (keep subject + template id); minimum fields only

activity: Privacy notice (eaglebed.co.uk) incl. B2B section and complaints route

activity: Right to object / unsubscribe handling

recommended_control: Any 'stop', 'remove me', 'not interested' on any channel -> suppression within 2 working days; no confirmation-marketing reply
